special_episode_count.reason: The sources identify the OAD as a single episode titled '#23 MOMENTS' (or 'MOMENT'). The total episode count of the series including this OAD is 23, with the TV series being 22 episodes, implying 1 OAD episode.

evidence.quote: 2015年5月15日に発売のコミックス最終11巻限定版に同梱!

special_release_date.reason: The OAD 'MOMENTS' (Episode 23) was released as a bonus for the limited edition of Volume 11 of the manga on May 15, 2015. While a BD-Box containing it was released later in 2020, the specific release date of the OAD content itself is tied to the manga volume.

answer.identity_notes: The target is the OAD 'MOMENTS' (Episode 23), which is distinct from the 22-episode TV series. It was originally released with the limited edition of Manga Volume 11 on 2015-05-15. A later BD-Box release in 2020 included this OAD along with the TV series, but the OAD's initial release date is 2015-05-15.
